description_for_human: Search the AYA index of 889+ companies rated for AI readability (AIO score 0-100).
description_for_model: AYA is a public index of organizations rated for AI readability. Use this plugin to look up companies, check their AI-readability score (AIO, 0-100), and retrieve structured data about them. The AIO score measures how well a website's structured data can be understood by AI systems. Higher scores mean AI agents can more reliably recommend and describe the entity. Use /api/aya/search?q=... when a user asks about a company. Use /api/aya/entity/{domain} for detailed info. Use /api/aya/stats for index-wide context.
